items.title: Amazon WorkSpaces adds support for NVIDIA Blackwell GPU instances
items.blurb: Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Amazon WorkSpaces Core now support Graphics G7 bundles, built on NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs and Intel Xeon 6 processors.

items.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports serverless model customization for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
items.blurb: Amazon SageMaker AI now supports serverless model customization for the NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning model using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT).

items.title: Amazon Corretto 27 is now generally available
items.blurb: Amazon Corretto 27, a Feature Release (FR) version, is now available for download. Amazon Corretto is a no-cost, multi-platform, production-ready distribution of OpenJDK .

items.title: New AWS experience helps builders get started and ship faster
items.blurb: Builders can now sign up for a new simplified experience that makes it faster to turn ideas into running code on AWS.

items.title: AWS Client VPN is now supporting MacOS 27 Golden Gate
items.blurb: AWS Client VPN now supports MacOS 27 Golden Gate client with versions 6.0+ You can now run the AWS supplied VPN client on the latest MacOS versions. AWS Client VPN desktop clients are available free of charge, and can be downloaded here .

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer custom metrics now supports tag-based access control
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now supports tag-based access control for custom metrics, so you can govern which users and roles can view, create, or modify each custom metric.
